blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The International Criminal Court (ICC) prosecution requested to submit evidence obtained from a former Davao City police officer and member of the Davao Death Squad (DDS), who is no longer available to testify in the trial of former President Rodrigo Duterte. This was contained in the nine-page request of Acting Prosecutor Mame Mandiaye Niang to the Pretrial Chamber III made public on Thursday, Nov. 5. Niang identified the witness as P-0002, who “was” a Philippine National Police (PNP) officer in Davao City and a “member” of DDS.
